<thought>We have located the consolidated polymorphs JSON file needed for preparing the ML-ready dataset. It is located at:
`/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/WORKDIR/6/1_prepare_ml_ready_dataset_trial_3/nitride_polymorphs.json`

Using the `prepare_tabular_dataset` tool with the specified parameters will generate the train/test CSV files and a metadata JSON file in the `nitride_ml_dataset` output directory. The metadata JSON will contain the required fields `features`, `train_path`, and `test_path`. After running the tool, we will return the path to the generated metadata JSON file as the final answer.</thought>
<action>prepare_tabular_dataset</action>
<action_input>{
    "polymorphs_json_path": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/WORKDIR/6/1_prepare_ml_ready_dataset_trial_3/nitride_polymorphs.json",
    "output_path": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/WORKDIR/6/1_prepare_ml_ready_dataset_trial_3/nitride_ml_dataset",
    "target_property": "formation_energy_per_atom",
    "feature_engineering": "advanced",
    "test_split": 0.2,
    "normalize": true
}</action_input>
